text: The Republic of Korea Landslide Information System (LIS) is a comprehensive, multi-component system designed to monitor, model, and provide early warnings for landslides across South Korea. It integrates efforts from various public and academic institutions to address the increasing risk of rainfall-induced landslides, exacerbated by climate change. The system includes national forecasting by the Korea Forest Service, machine learning-based susceptibility mapping by the OJeong Resilience Institute, and in-situ monitoring by KIGAM, providing a robust framework for landslide risk management.
